description.name: Xtream AI Panel
description.tagline: Provision Xtream AI IPTV lines from WHMCS.
description.short: Create, renew, suspend, unsuspend, and terminate IPTV lines using a connected Xtream AI panel.
description.long: Server module for provisioning IPTV lines against the Xtream AI panel API. Pair it with the Xtream AI Panel addon to connect one or more panels.
